title: Andijon şahar, Namuna MFY, Abdurauf Fitrat köçasi 230-uyda joylaşgan “Kinematografiya agentligi Andijon viloyati hududiy boşqarmasi” bino-inşootlarini baholaş hizmati.

criteria.label: Ишларни бажариш ёки хизматларни кўрсатиш учун тегишли зарурий жиҳозлар, асбоблар ва технологик воситаларга қўйиладиган талаблар. subject_uz: Andijon shahridagi Kinematografiya agentligi hududiy boshqarmasi bino-inshootlarini baholash xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Milliy standartlar bo'yicha baholangan kamida 3 ta o'xshash loyiha tajribasi bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At least 3 similar valuation projects done under national standards.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma tuzilgunga qadar kamida 1 yil baholash faoliyati bilan shug'ullangan bo'lish kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At least one year of valuation activity before the contract is signed.
requirements.quote: kamida 1 yil davomida (aktivlarni) baholash faoliyatini amalga oshirish

requirements.summary_uz: Baholovchining malaka sertifikati va professional birlashmaga a'zolik hujjati taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: The appraiser's qualification certificate and professional association membership are provided.
requirements.quote: baholashda bevosita ishtirok etadigan baholovchining (baholovchilarning) malaka sertifikatini taqdim etishi

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash shartnoma tuzilgandan so'ng 7 ish kunida yakunlanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The valuation is completed within 7 working days after signing the contract.

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash 2026-yil 1-oktabr holatiga, bozor qiymatini aniqlash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Valuation as of 1 October 2026, determining market value.

requirements.summary_uz: Hisobotda baholovchining mulkning bozor qiymati to'g'risidagi professional xulosasi bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The report must contain the appraiser's professional conclusion on market value.
requirements.quote: Hisobotda baholovchining baholanayotgan mulkning bozor qiymati to'g'risidagi professional xulosasi bo'lishi kerak

requirements.summary_uz: Malakali baholovchi haqida ma'lumot (sertifikat) uchun 15 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 15 points for information on the qualified appraiser (certificate).

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari mavjud bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, financial, material and staff resources needed to perform the contract.
requirements.quote: Шартномани бажариш учун зарур техник, молиявий, моддий, кадрлар ресурсларининг ҳамда бошқа ресурсларнинг мавжудлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha muddati o'tgan qarzdorlik bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: No overdue tax or fee debt.
requirements.quote: Солиқлар ва йиғимларни тўлаш бўйича муддати ўтган қарздорликнинг мавжуд эмаслиги.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 172 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 57% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 21%.
reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.
In the customer's last 172 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 57% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 21%.

documents_needed_uz: O'xshash baholash loyihalari bo'yicha mijozlar ro'yxati, aloqa ma'lumotlari va tavsiyanomalar
Baholovchining malaka sertifikati va baholovchilar uyushmasiga a'zolik hujjatlari
Bajarilgan ishlar bo'yicha shartnomalar va hisob-fakturalar
